messages.subject: workflowr 1.3.0
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I just submitted workflowr 1.3.0 <https://github.com/jdblischak/workflowr/releases/tag/v1.3.0> to CRAN. To update now, you can install the master branch of the GitHub repo.

Many thanks to the multiple contributors to this release. If you'd like to contribute to the development of workflowr, please let me know!

Best,

John

Below are the release notes:

New functions

The new function wflow_toc() builds a table of contents of the published R
Markdown files in a workflowr project (@JiaxiangBU <https://github.com/JiaxiangBU>, #151 <https://github.com/jdblischak/workflowr/issues/151>, #155 <https://github.com/jdblischak/workflowr/pull/155>)

The new function wflow_rename_proj() renames a workflowr project throughout
all its project files (idea from @frm1789 <https://github.com/frm1789> and @kbroman <https://github.com/kbroman>, #148 <https://github.com/jdblischak/workflowr/issues/148>)
RStudio Addins

RStudio Addins <https://rstudio.github.io/rstudioaddins/> allow you to execute R code via the RStudio
Addins menu. For extra convenience, you can bind the addins to keyboard
shortcuts <https://rstudio.github.io/rstudioaddins/#keyboard-shorcuts>. The following workflowr functions have
addins:
wflow_build()
wflow_publish()
wflow_status()
wflow_toc()
wflow_view()

Note that the addin for wflow_publish() is a Shiny Gadget that enables you to
interactively choose which files to publish and write a detailed commit message
(assistance from @zaynaib <https://github.com/zaynaib> and @argdata <https://github.com/argdata>, #143 <https://github.com/jdblischak/workflowr/issues/143>).
Minor improvements and bug fixes

wflow_build() fails early if pandoc is not installed (@zaynaib <https://github.com/zaynaib>, #75 <https://github.com/jdblischak/workflowr/issues/75>)

wflow_git_push()/wflow_git_pull() fail early if user tries to use SSH
authentication when it is not supported by the current installation of
git2r/libgit2 (#144 <https://github.com/jdblischak/workflowr/issues/144>)

Fix support for knitr chunk option collapse and indent (reported by
@pcarbo <https://github.com/pcarbo>, #149 <https://github.com/jdblischak/workflowr/issues/149>)

Fix support for rmarkdown option keep_md (see
rmarkdown Issue 1558 <https://github.com/rstudio/rmarkdown/issues/1558>)

Skip tests that only fail on CRAN servers (this is why there are no macOS
binaries for 1.2.0)

Add a GitHub Pull Request template

Rename reproducibility tab "Report" to "Checks" (idea from @pcarbo <https://github.com/pcarbo>)

Fix spacing issue with session information button (reported by @pcarbo <https://github.com/pcarbo>, #157 <https://github.com/jdblischak/workflowr/issues/157>)

wflow_status() reports if the configuration files _workflowr.yml and
_site.yml have been edited

Disable inline code chunks by default in R Markdown files created by
workflowr. Document how to use inline code chunks in the FAQ <https://github.com/jdblischak/workflowr/blob/articles/wflow-05-faq.html> (discussed
with @rgayler <https://github.com/rgayler> and @Robinlovelace <https://github.com/Robinlovelace> , #140 <https://github.com/jdblischak/workflowr/issues/140>)
